# Comparison where the rest responds / 其余回应时的比较

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`comparison-where-the-rest-responds` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](comparison-where-the-rest-responds.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where every formation outside a part responds through its registration, comparing two flows is decided within the part's responsive reach: beyond it each formation registers and exchanges alike and the difference never arrives; registering support only, that reach is the union of the reach closures.
>
> 部分之外的形成都经自己之识回应时，两个流的比较在部分的回应所及之内决定：其外的每个形成识得相同、交换相同，差别到不了它；只识支持时，回应所及是所及闭包之并。

## Laws / 规律

1. Responsive reach: for two flows, two webs, an observation and a part (a decided family of formations), a formation lies within the part's responsive reach when it lies within some member's closure under the relation ‘a exchanges, in one of the two flows, with a condition b registers’; every member lies within it, and what lies beyond is outside the part.<br>回应所及：对两个流、两个网、一个观察与部分（判定的形成家族），一个形成在部分的回应所及之内，是指它在某个成员对“a 在两个流之一中与 b 所识的条件交换”这一关系的闭包之内；每个成员都在其中，其外的都在部分之外。 (`Becoming.Flow.WithinResponse`, `Becoming.Flow.RegisteredFromEither`, `Becoming.WithinClosure`, `Becoming.Flow.member_within_response`, `Becoming.Flow.outside_part_of_beyond_response`)
2. The closure under a converse is the converse of the closure, so a formation lies within the responsive reach exactly when some member lies within its registration closure drawn through both flows; with one flow, exactly when some member lies within its registration closure.<br>对逆关系的闭包是闭包之逆，所以一个形成在回应所及之内，恰当某个成员在它经两个流画出的识闭包之内；一个流时，恰当某个成员在它的识闭包之内。 (`Becoming.WithinClosure.converse`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_iff_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinRegistration`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_self_iff`)
3. What the part reaches and each member's reach closure lie within the responsive reach; registering support only, with one flow, a formation lies within it exactly when it lies within some member's reach closure; the reach closure is the converse of the influence closure.<br>部分所到达的与每个成员的所及闭包都在回应所及之内；只识支持、一个流时，一个形成在回应所及之内恰当它在某个成员的所及闭包之内；所及闭包是影响闭包之逆。 (`Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_of_reaches`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_of_withinReach`, `Becoming.supportOnly`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_supportOnly_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.withinReach_iff_withinInfluence`)
4. The rest responds through its registration when each formation outside the part that has registered alike, under the first web, between the levels of the two webs up to step t takes from and gives to every condition alike in the two flows at step t; with the rest fixed (the second flow withholding the part) this holds whatever registers.<br>其余经识回应：部分之外的每个形成，凡在第一个网下对两个网的水平直到第 t 步识得相同，在第 t 步与每个条件的取用与给予在两个流中相同；其余固定（第二个流扣下部分）时无论识什么它都成立。 (`Becoming.Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo`, `Becoming.Flow.respondsThroughRegistration_withhold`)
5. The formations beyond the responsive reach form a region closed in both flows under being registered from, directly from the definition of the closure.<br>回应所及之外的形成构成在两个流中都对“被识自”封闭的区域，由闭包的定义直接得到。 (`Becoming.Flow.beyond_response_closed`, `Becoming.Flow.RegisteredFrom`)
6. Confinement: where the two flows have the same formations present at every step, balance at each step on every condition registered by a formation beyond the reach and start alike there, and the rest responds through its registration, every formation beyond the responsive reach registers alike and exchanges alike with every condition at every step (an instance of likeness within a closed region).<br>限定：两个流的在场形成每步相同，在回应所及之外者所识的每个条件上逐步平衡且起始相同，其余经识回应时，回应所及之外的每个形成每步识得相同，并与每个条件交换相同（封闭区域内相同的实例）。 (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn`, `Becoming.Flow.alike_beyond_response`, `Becoming.Flow.alike_within_closed`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_alike_beyond_response`)
7. Under the same conditions, the totals the two flows take from and give to each condition such a formation registers are alike at every step, and the difference between the flows reaches it before no step.<br>同样条件下，两个流每步从这样的形成所识的每个条件取用与向它给予的总量相同，两个流的差别在任何一步之前都到不了它。 (`Becoming.Flow.totals_alike_beyond_response`, `Becoming.Flow.not_differs_beyond_response`, `Becoming.Flow.DiffersBefore`)
8. Where both flows balance, share the formations present, start alike and the rest responds through registration, for any significance covering from p every formation not beyond the responsive reach, the levels of the first web retain what has significance along those of the second exactly when they include them, and the reverse, and neither adds a continuation with significance exactly when neither exceeds the other.<br>所以两个流都平衡、在场形成相同、起始相同、其余经识回应时，对从 p 覆盖每个不在回应所及之外的形成的任何意义，第一个网的水平保留第二个网的水平上有意义者恰当前者包含后者，反过来也是；两者都不增加有意义的延续恰当两者都不超出对方。 (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_difference`)
9. The cover is double-negated because the difference shows only that a formation it reaches is not beyond the reach; where membership is decidable, covering the responsive reach suffices.<br>覆盖写成双重否定，因为差别只表明它到达的形成不在回应所及之外；回应所及可判定时，覆盖回应所及即可。 (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response_of_decidable`)
10. Witness, the trophic cascade: between the flow with the wolves and the flow in which the deer respond, the premise holds registering support only, and the forest lies within the wolves' responsive reach, which their part does not reach.<br>见证，营养级联：在狼群之流与鹿有回应之流之间，只识支持时前提成立；森林在狼群的回应所及之内，而狼群的部分到达不了它。 (`Becoming.Trophic.responds_through_registration`, `Becoming.Trophic.forest_within_response`)
11. There the responsive reach is exactly the wolves, the deer and the forest; for any significance covering these three from p at every step, the two level paths retain along each other exactly as they include each other, and since each exceeds the other, neither retains.<br>那里回应所及恰是狼群、鹿与森林；对从 p 每步覆盖这三者的任何意义，两条水平路径恰如彼此包含那样彼此保留，而两者互相超出，所以都不保留。 (`Becoming.Trophic.within_response_iff`, `Becoming.Trophic.responsiveReach_closed`, `Becoming.Trophic.far_unaffected`, `Becoming.Trophic.den_untouched`, `Becoming.Trophic.responsive_comparison`)
12. Witness, an escalation loop: two formations each require and observe their own condition; in the flow with the act the first takes from the second's condition at step 0 and the second responds at step 1 by taking from the first's, while in the other flow nothing is taken; both flows balance, activity needs support, they start alike and the second responds through its registration.<br>见证，升级回路：两个形成各需要并观察自己的条件；有动作之流中第一个在第 0 步从第二个的条件取用，第二个在第 1 步回应、从第一个的条件取用，无动作之流什么都不取用；两个流平衡，活动需要支持，起始相同，第二个经识回应。 (`Becoming.Loop.escalation`, `Becoming.Loop.quiet`, `Becoming.Loop.balances`, `Becoming.Loop.quiet_balances`, `Becoming.Loop.dependent`, `Becoming.Loop.quiet_dependent`, `Becoming.Loop.responds`)
13. There the first's own exchange with its condition is the same in both flows, yet with the act the first is unsupported at step 2 and without it supported; with the rest fixed the first's part does not reach the first, while the difference between the flows reaches it before step 2.<br>那里第一个自身与其条件的交换在两个流中相同，而有动作时第一个在第 2 步不被支持，无动作时被支持；其余固定时第一个的部分到达不了第一个，而两流的差别在第 2 步之前到达它。 (`Becoming.Loop.returns`)

## Conditions / 条件

- Responding through registration (Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration) is a supplied premise in these laws, which use it only beyond the responsive reach; it excludes responding to what is not registered, noise, and outside inputs not represented as conditions.<br>经识回应（Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration）在这些定律中是给出的前提，定律只在回应所及之外用到它；它排除对未被识者的回应、噪声与未表示为条件的外来输入。
- Where the rest follows a law of exchange reading only what each formation registers, the premise is a theorem for any two courses of the law (ExchangeLaw.Through.responds, counterfactual-is-the-course).<br>其余遵从一个只读各形成所识的交换律时，该前提对律的任意两个进程是定理（ExchangeLaw.Through.responds，见 counterfactual-is-the-course）。
- Every law of what has stood reads through registering everything, and with finitely many conditions through its sensitivity (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive); with the law's sensitivity as the registration those responses fall within it and the responsive reach widens.<br>每个读已立者的律经识一切而读，条件有限时经其敏感而读（ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive）；取律的敏感为识时，那些回应落在识之内，回应所及随之变宽。
- The hypotheses then still taken: the law of exchange itself; that it reads what has stood (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating); with the second flow the course another act generates, that course's feasibility (ExchangeLaw.Feasible, equivalent to its balance); and for the sensitivity form, finitely many conditions with decidable equality.<br>这时仍取的假设：交换律本身；它读已立者（ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating）；第二个流为另一动作生成的进程时，进程可行（ExchangeLaw.Feasible，等价于它平衡）；敏感的形式还要条件有限、条件的相等可判定。
- The confinement laws assume balance at each step only on the conditions registered by formations beyond the responsive reach (Flow.BalancesOn), the same formations present in both flows at every step, and a common start on those conditions.<br>限定的定律只在回应所及之外者所识的条件上逐步假设平衡（Flow.BalancesOn），并假设两个流的在场形成每步相同、在那些条件上起始相同。
- The main comparison assumes both flows balance throughout (Flow.Balances) and start alike; the significance sig is supplied, and the cover is double-negated, with no decision used; the decidable form takes the decision of the responsive reach as a hypothesis.<br>主比较假设两个流全局平衡（Flow.Balances）、起始相同；意义 sig 是给定的，覆盖写成双重否定，不用判定；可判定的形式另取回应所及的判定为假设。
- A part is a decided family of formations; the responsive reach is drawn through both flows.<br>部分是判定的形成家族；回应所及经两个流画出。
- For the trophic cascade and the loop: the witnesses' flows, webs and parts; the trophic flow in which the deer respond (Trophic.responsiveFlow, responsiveWeb) is the one the feedback laws supplied.<br>营养级联与回路的结论：见证的流、网与部分；营养级联中鹿有回应的流（Trophic.responsiveFlow、responsiveWeb）是反馈定律给出的那一个。
- Steps are counted from step 0; levels, needs and amounts are natural numbers. The axiom Unrestricted does not occur.<br>步从第 0 步计；水平、所需与数量是自然数。不用公理 Unrestricted。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Responding only through registration is supplied: neither that formations respond so nor how they respond follows here.<br>形成只经其识回应是给出的前提：在此既不推出它们这样回应，也不推出怎样回应。
- The responsive reach is drawn through both flows, so it needs which conditions the second flow exchanges with; with the rest fixed it is drawn in the first flow, through Flow.withhold_exchanges, with no separate theorem here.<br>回应所及经两个流画出，须知第二个流与哪些条件交换；其余固定时由 Flow.withhold_exchanges 在原流中画出，本模块没有另立定理。
- The responsive reach is an upper bound: it does not say which formations within it the difference reaches, nor how much, and it is not ordered in time.<br>回应所及是上界：不说差别到达其中的哪个形成，不量差别多少，也不按时间先后。
- The premise is stronger than what the laws use, which is only the exchange of formations beyond the reach on what they register.<br>前提强于定律所用的；定律只用回应所及之外者在其所识条件上的交换。
- In the trophic cascade the responding flow is supplied and only checked against the premise.<br>营养级联中有回应的流仍是给出的，只检查它满足前提。
- The loop is a minimal two-party witness (one act, one response, requiring and observing coinciding), not a general definition of a loop; no gain or runaway theorem is stated.<br>回路是最小的两方见证（一个动作、一次回应，需要与观察重合），不是回路的一般定义；没有增益或失控的定理。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** The bound with the rest fixed is strictly smaller than the responsive reach: in the trophic cascade the wolves' part does not reach the forest, while the forest lies within the wolves' responsive reach (Trophic.forest_within_response) and the difference between the flows reaches it (Trophic.difference_reaches_forest). In Loop the difference returns to the part's own support, while the part does not reach itself (Loop.returns): the comparison with the rest fixed misses the loop.<br>其余固定的界严格小于回应所及：营养级联中狼群的部分到达不了森林，而森林在狼群的回应所及之内（Trophic.forest_within_response），两流的差别到达它（Trophic.difference_reaches_forest）。Loop 中差别回到部分自身的支持，而部分到达不了它自己（Loop.returns）：其余固定的比较漏掉回路。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Response.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** The premise can fail: in Attracting the taker registers nothing (it requires nothing and registers support only), yet takes more where the stock is higher (Attracting.higher_breaks_first); by inspection, with no part, responding through registration fails there, and the confinement is not claimed. This module states no separate theorem for it.<br>前提可以不成立：Attracting 中取用者什么都不识（不需要任何条件、只识支持），却在储量较高时多取用（Attracting.higher_breaks_first）；按检视，那里没有部分时经识回应不成立，限定不被主张。本模块没有为此另立定理。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准，在陈述有其确切意义处采用（Ren，2026年10月12日）；未注明属于 Ren 的读法，依 Ren 2026年10月15日的交托由 AI 决定，Ren 可以改动。

### Correspondence / 对应

After the AI compared the theory with a general cause–effect system (x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t), feedback, adaptive parameters, attractors) and proposed five improvements, Ren wrote: “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the second proposal, the AI's: the counterfactual where the rest responds, answering, for the case where the rest responds through its registration, the chapter's open item “the counterfactual in which the rest of the exchange adjusts”. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): an act has two counterfactuals, with the rest fixed, where only what the part reaches directly counts, and with the rest responding through its registration, where the part's closure under affecting what is registered counts; what an act does to formations that interact with it is decided within the second; an escalation loop is the case where each party responds through its registration and the difference returns to the part, which does not show in the comparison with the rest fixed; registering support only, the responsive reach is the union of the reach closures, which gives the reach closure a counterfactual meaning: where the difference an act makes can arrive when the rest responds through its support. The cause–effect text pasted in the source, including its arms-race loop, has no stated author; it is not Ren's wording and not a premise of the theory.<br>AI 把本理论与一般的因果系统（x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t)、反馈、自适应参数、吸引子）作比较并提出五项改进之后，Ren 写道：“Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”。本项是其中第二项（提议是 AI 的）：其余回应时的反事实，回答本章开放项“其余交换随之调整的反事实”中其余经识回应的情形。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：一个动作有两种反事实，其余固定时只计部分直接到达的，其余经识回应时计部分对经所识者影响的闭包；一个动作对与之相互作用的形成造成什么，在第二种之内决定；升级回路是每一方都经识回应、差别回到部分的情形，它不在其余固定的比较中出现；只识支持时回应所及是所及闭包之并，这给所及闭包一个反事实的意义：其余经其支持回应时，一个动作的差别所能到之处。来源中粘贴的因果系统文字（含军备竞赛的回路）作者未注明，不是 Ren 的话，也不是本理论的前提。

  - Input / 输入: 限定的局部平衡假设。 / The local balance hypotheses of the confinement.
  - Preserved conditions / 保留条件: 无。 / None. [Flow.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [runaway-distance-unregistered](runaway-distance-unregistered.md). 那里的下一步要求定义回路（水平影响取用、取用又影响水平）并把失控陈述为定理。Loop 只走了一小步：它是比较中一个定义好的两方回路的见证，其中第一个形成的动作经第二个的观察与回应回到第一个自身的支持，而其余固定的比较看不到它（Loop.returns）。它不是回路的一般定义，只有一个动作、一次回应、一个回合，没有增益或放大，也没有失控的定理；那里其余固定的假设在这里换为经识回应。 / Its next step asks to define a loop (levels affecting taking, and taking the levels) and to state a runaway itself as a theorem. Loop goes only a small way: it is a witness of a defined two-party loop in the comparison, in which the first formation's act returns to its own support through the second's observation and response, which the comparison with the rest fixed does not show (Loop.returns). It is not a general definition of a loop; it has one act, one response and one round, no gain or amplification, and no runaway theorem; the rest held fixed there is replaced here by responding through registration.
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [counterfactual-is-the-course](counterfactual-is-the-course.md). 推出本记录的前提：其余遵从一个只读各形成所识的交换律时，其余经识回应是定理；第二个流是另一动作生成的进程，比较不另给第二个流与回应；Loop.responds 由律推出（Loop.responds_by_law）。 / Derives this record's premise: where the rest follows a law of exchange reading only what each formation registers, responding through registration is a theorem; the second flow is the course another act generates, so the comparison supplies neither the second flow nor the response; Loop.responds follows from the law (Loop.responds_by_law).
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [how-much-difference-arrives](how-much-difference-arrives.md). 回答其下一步中的两项：差别到达多少至多是所携带的量，恰好达到；它恰沿正强度的时间路线为正（carried_pos_iff）。回路只有见证：强度为一的回路使一个单位每步加倍（Propagation.Loop.runaway）。 / Answers two items of its next step: how much difference arrives is at most the carried amount, which is attained, and is positive exactly along a route in time of positive strengths (carried_pos_iff). Loops have witnesses only: a loop of strength one doubles a unit every step (Propagation.Loop.runaway).
- related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [how-a-carried-difference-grows](how-a-carried-difference-grows.md). 回答其下一步中回路的一项，在其余遵从具有给定耦合强度之律处：回路是经正强度的耦合回到出发条件的链（OnLoop），绕回路的强度是一加回路上强度之积，到达回路者每圈至少乘以它（carried_runaway），形成与强度每步相同时有多项式界恰在上游没有回路处。 / Answers the item on loops in its next step, where the rest follows a law with given coupling strengths: a loop is a chain of couplings of positive strength back to where it started (OnLoop), the strength around it is one plus the product of its strengths, by which what reaches it is multiplied every time around (carried_runaway), and with the same formations and strengths at every step a polynomial bound holds exactly where no loop lies upstream.
